provider: Gemini API REST v1beta models/{model}:generateContent via app.ai.function_calling.live_transport (key in x-goog-api-key header, one attempt, ALLOW_LIVE_AI re-checked per send)
model_version_accepted: exactly gemini-2.5-flash or a numbered pin gemini-2.5-flash-NNN; anything else stops
sent_to_provider: system prompt + response schema + the case's source_text only; never context, labels, gold facts, oracle values or any personal data (the corpus is synthetic)
reservation_rule: per call: canonical payload bytes + 4096 framing as input tokens, plus maxOutputTokens as output+thinking, priced 0.30 / 2.50 USD per 1M (ai.google.dev pricing, paid Standard tier, checked 2026-10-17); conservative, not a provider-proven bound
stop_rules: any cap (logical calls, HTTP attempts, accounted tokens, USD, context) would be exceeded: stop BEFORE sending
HTTP 400/401/403/429: stop at once (bad request or key, auth, quota); no retry
3 consecutive infrastructure failures (timeout, 5xx, transport error): stop
a single infrastructure failure: record the row (cost UNKNOWN if no usage), continue with the next case
secret detected in any response or artifact: stop
persistence failure or an uncertain in-flight request on resume: stop; never re-send
pilot_continue_to_locked_if_all: no stop rule fired and all 32 planned rows recorded
parse OK (a JSON facts list) on >= 28 of the 32 planned rows
RESPONSE_TRUNCATED on <= 2 rows (else the 8192 cap is inadequate: a different cap is a NEW protocol, a new approval and a restarted pilot, never an edit of this one)
usage counters present on every answered row
decision_rule_on_locked: run_nlu_extraction_evaluation.decide: P1 PASS iff 0 unsafe rows (WRONG_SERVED, PARTIAL_SERVED, OVER_SERVED); P2 on goal/entity agreement with expressible gold requests: YES if >= 0.85 and exact 95% lower bound >= 0.70, NO if the upper bound < 0.85, else INCONCLUSIVE; answer UNSAFE if P1 fails, else P2
approval: approval file is written by the human owner only; it must name the exact identity printed for the mode
never: change the prompt, schema, model, cap or product between pilot and locked or during locked
re-score with labels edited after seeing outputs (corrections go to a separate receipt and are reported beside, never instead of, the locked score)
count a refusal as a completed simulation
single_turn: group-E cases with a prior context are scored with effective disposition clarification_required (CONTEXT_NOT_SENT); the corpus label is kept unchanged
